style_profiles.guidance: Use concrete maritime details, restrained suspicion, and concise sentences. Preserve authored names, quantities, and state terms exactly.

positive_examples: Rain silvered the sealed ledger while the harbor watch counted every departing hull.

positive_examples: The blockade bell struck once. Mara was already running.

style_profiles.guidance: Polish the selected prose into crisp maritime suspense. Keep every authored fact, proper name, quantity, quotation, and state reference unchanged.
